messages:
maria: Heads-up — PR 9242 is blocking the rc4 cutover, we need 2x LGTM before 11:30 PT (cutoff in 35m). Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9242 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
alex: on it, pinging @kevin and @sam for second eyes.
kevin: I'll take a look in 5. If tests pass, I'll approve. Any risky migrations?
maria: no DB changes; tiny config flag for batching warmup. Quick smoke in staging passed.
tia: I can do a quick read now. flagging a potential nits in the handler but not blocking.
sam: skimming now. If you can add a tiny test for the edge case I left in comments I'll LGTM after.
alex: @maria can you add the test? shouldn't take long.
maria: pushed a 1-line unit test. CI kicked off.
ci-bot: Build #1789 started for PR 9242 — tests: unit, integration, lint.
kevin: CI green on my end — left one comment about logging level. Not blocking though. giving LGTM.
sam: CI passed. comment addressed. LGTM from me. @maria you can merge when cutover window opens.
maria: thanks everyone! merging at cutoff. I'll tag release notes and roll forward if anything flakey.
tia: :thumbsup: good luck. I'll watch canary.
alex: leaving a note in release channel. Nice turn-around.
maria: merging now. if rollback needed, I'll open a revert PR immediately.
